title: Talk 1
original: Princess Fumizuki is my master, and you're my employer.

title: Talk 2
original: My hobby? Standing on the coast, watching the snow fall.

title: Talk after Promotion 2
original: My weapon? A shuriken, the Silver Wind, made by Eastern Heavy Industries.

title: Onboard
original: I am Shirayuki. Princess Fumizuki told me to assist Miss Ch'en and follow all your orders.

title: Promotion 1
original: A promotion? I, Shirayuki, am honored.

title: Promotion 2
original: I, Shirayuki, may devote greater strength to you.

title: Begin Operation
original: A snowstorm will bury this battlefield.

title: 4-star Result
original: The enemy dies, I advance. I advance, the enemy dies.

title: 3-star Result
original: The enemy has fallen. Total victory.

title: Sub 3-star Result
original: Of their ranks, some flee. Wariness, a must.

title: Operation Failure
original: Should we fight again, we will return the favor one hundredfold.

title: Trust Tap
original: Your consideration, I, Shirayuki, will engrave upon my heart.

title: New Year's blessing
original: Happy New Year. May all proceed as you will it.

title: Birthday
original: Happy birthday. Please take this present. No, 'tis no bidding of the Princess.

title: Anniversary Celebration
original: I, ShiraYuki, here ever keep my watch. In duty, and our bonds.
